data.originalIdea: Why AI-generated music all sounds the same
Why AI-generated music all sounds the same

data.idea: AI music all sounds the same because the models optimize for average taste

beats.transcript: Every AI track sounds pleasant. So why does none of it stick with you?
Because the model flattens outliers to avoid risk. Novelty lives in the edges it smooths away.
Push the weird parameter. Embrace the ugly take. That is where memorable AI music is hiding.
